meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Hostinger vs Namecheap: Price, Renewals, Tests (2026)
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Hostinger vs Namecheap hosting on promo and renewal prices, same-size entry plans, uptime and speed tests, AI tools and Black Friday offers.
meta.rl_answer: The entry plans are the same size. Hostinger has the lower sale price and faster test numbers. Namecheap has the lower renewal price.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Hostinger better than Namecheap? | Hostinger has the lower sale price and faster test numbers. Namecheap has the lower renewal price.
Which is cheaper, Hostinger or Namecheap? | Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99. Namecheap Stellar is $2.28 a month and renews at $5.88.
Are the entry plans the same size? | Yes. Both list 3 sites and 20 GB of SSD storage.
Which has better test results? | All About Cookies measured 100% uptime for Hostinger. Cybernews measured 99.29% for Namecheap. The tests used different methods and dates.
Does Namecheap have a Black Friday sale? | We found none on its pages. Its Black Friday page referred to 2025.

meta.rl_takeaways:
The entry plans are the same size: 3 sites and 20 GB.
Hostinger is $1.99 a month and Namecheap is $2.28.
Namecheap renews at $5.88 a month against $10.99 for Hostinger.
Test results come from different publishers and dates.

meta.rl_c_verdict: Hostinger is cheaper first and tested faster. Namecheap is cheaper to keep. Neither host was tested by us.
